fact: A May 2026 study used multi-temporal Sentinel-2 images with ERA5-Land and CHIRPS data to predict early-season rice yields in Kambia and Bombali districts, across seven seasons 2018-2024.
title: An Ensemble Machine Learning Approach for Pre-Harvest Rice Yield Forecasting in Sierra Leone Using Sentinel-2 and Multi-Source Climate Data
publisher: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology
